At Real Men Apparel, we believe men deserve better. Founded by Jared and Jill Mortensen in 2021 in Wichita, Kansas, our company was born out of frustration with the poorly fitting, outdated designs offered by billion-dollar multinational brands. We asked ourselves: why hasn’t men’s underwear evolved to fit the diverse shapes and sizes of real men?

So, we decided to fight back.

Jared Mortensen, with his extensive background in finance, operations, design, and supply chain management from leading companies like Boeing, Spirit AeroSystems, Textron, Koch Industries, and Cosmic Pet, took on the challenge. He meticulously studied thousands of underwear products from around the world, integrating advanced design principles with high-quality, dynamic materials to create something revolutionary.

At the heart of our innovation is the REAL pouch system, offering four different pouch sizes to ensure the perfect fit for every man. Combined with a wide range of waist sizes from XS to 5XL, our underwear is designed for real comfort, real style, and real confidence.

We’re not just another brand; we’re a movement. Join Jared, Jill, and the rest of our growing team, including members in Kansas (with two of the Mortensen sons), North Carolina, Georgia, Bolivia, and the Philippines, in the Real Men revolution.

Real Confidence, Real Style – REAL MEN!

Try yourself on for size and experience the difference today.
